_comment: Hand-maintained inputs of the progress page (research/tools/build_progress.py). Numbers shown on the page are computed from research/results.tsv and research/models/*.meta, never typed here.

milestones.label: Leak-free agent beats the cheating lightspeed reference
A0 val win ≥ 25% / 30%, first test runs
A0 test ≥ 35%, start the A10 track
A0 test ≥ 50% (chests opened: 54.6% test)
Keys and Act 4 playable, Heart track with its own best
Phase S: learned leaf value vs rollouts (closed by its gate: -0.57 at best)
Phase S2: leaf value trained on tree leaves (-0.45 -> -0.35 with 4× data; line open)
Phase R: learned run value — closed at stage 2, no keep (ridge beats nets; data-limited)
Real-game bridge via Communication Mod (separate thread, user's machine)
A10 ≥ 35% (now below)
A20 Heart track
Shared data store (private Hugging Face dataset) for parallel workers
Phase R2: learned run value at 10^5 runs — first learned-value keep (vr2b20: +4.8 pts pooled 400)
Phase R3: run value at 1.7×10^5 runs — A0 keep vr3b40 (bonus 40), pooled 400 P=0.900
Phase R4: A10 run value — fit 0.709 -> 0.544 on the A10 holdout, card picks no keep (b20 pooled 400 P=0.802; three A10 near misses)
Phase R5: run value on boss relics — KEEP on all four tracks (A0 +2.3 val / +6.0 dev; A10 38.7% val; A20 5.6% pooled; Heart marginal). M-A10 test 32.2% [28.3, 36.4]: not confirmed
Phase R8: A20 run value — fit 0.880 -> 0.338 on the A20 holdout, card picks + relics no keep (pooled 500: 3.6% vs 5.6%; scale-matched 32: still negative)
A20 boss-search reallocation: no keep (compute-neutral x1.5 / x2 and +compute x2 all lose ~2–3 pts)
Selection bias found (A20 best 5.6% -> 4.4% on fresh seeds); keep rule now uses a never-used seed slice per decision (exp_fresh.sh)
Phase X1: exploration data for the run value (90,000 A0 games, 20% random card/relic picks), then pure-V vs KB+V

phases.name: Phases 1–2
phases.summary: Leak-free MCTS, frozen harness and leak test, simulator root-cause fixes

phases.name: Phase A–B
phases.summary: Feature extractors, loggers, trainer; learned root move prior kept (+3.6 pts)

phases.name: Phase C
phases.summary: Interventional deck-value model (+4.0 pts), kept on every track

phases.name: Phase D
phases.summary: A10, A20 and Heart tracks; Heart 8.2% → 12.0% pooled overnight

phases.name: Phase S
phases.summary: Learned leaf value replacing rollouts: fit scales, play does not (-0.57 at best)

phases.name: Phase S2
phases.summary: Leaf value trained on the states the search evaluates: -0.45; 4x data next

phases.name: Phase R
phases.summary: Learned V(run) ≈ E[score]: ridge best (corr 0.34); card picks no keep; replacement −0.09

phases.name: Bridge
phases.summary: Mirror-mode verification against the real game, then live play

next_up: Phase F15 (running): play-test the keys-aware Heart V anyway (disclosed post-hoc), as sole card judge and as a weighted bonus.
All keep decisions now on fresh seed slices (base re-run on each); next: re-measure every track's current best on a fresh slice to report honest numbers.

Phase R next: the run value on the remaining strategic decisions that were not tested (events, rest vs smith, path choice), and a fresh look at the A10 val split's selection bias (val 38.7% vs test 32.2%).

Data format: 1,000-run zlib shards instead of one file per run (measured 47–73x smaller; ~1,000x fewer files, which is what limits transfer speed and the Hub commit rate). After R4 training; switch only on a bit-identical retrain.
Phase S2: 4× leaf data moved the best learned leaf from -0.45 to -0.35 (sv16); still far below rollouts. The next step is more leaf data, practical once workers share data.
A10/A20 ports of A0 keeps (worker session a10ports): map discount 0.85, potion values, act-1 elite weight; the Heart track predicts most fail.
Heart: conversion in the Heart fight itself (keys are ≈ 96% complete). A20: parked until a structural idea for act-2 deck strength.
done: Leak-free combat search: determinised MCTS, 500 simulations, leak test on every build.
Simulator root-cause fixes (potions, Dome intents, events, hangs, Neow's Lament); results re-baselined.
Treasure chests opened (+19.7 pts, the largest single gain).
Learned root move prior (+3.6) and interventional deck-value model (+4.0); M5 test 66.6%.
Keys and Act 4; Heart track: act-4 shop potions, act-3 burning elite, act-3 ruby key, boss relics by simulated fights.
Statistical hygiene: pre-registration, replication slices, pooled 500/600 rules, bit-identity checks.
Phase S scaling grid (9 cells + control) and Phase S2 (leaf-distribution training).
Phase X1: exploration data (90,000 A0 games with random card/relic picks) -> run value vr_151; new A0 best x1add (+2.0 pts, P 0.91); V-only picks now tie KB + V (-0.4) where the old V lost 7 points.

Simulator switch (2026-11-06): loop moved to the real-game-matched fork; leak tests pass on all tracks; honest fork levels A0 79.6 / A10 36.1 / A20 3.0 / Heart 11.8% (legacy 85.1 / 37.2 / 6.35 / 12.7).

Phase F1: V retrained on 120,000 fork games (vr_171): most accurate V on every track's fork holdout; Heart best improved (pooled 2,000 games 13.1% -> 14.3% Heart wins, P 0.997); A0 tie; A10 / A20 small positive, not significant.

Phase F2: more weight for the fork V — new best on every track: A0 +3.6 pts (84.0% on a second fresh slice), A10 +5.2 pts, A20 and Heart better floor / act-4 progress (Heart via V-only card and relic picks).
Phase F3: A20 2.25x V weights (wins 3.2 -> 4.1%, 2,000 games, P 0.995) and A10 V-only card / relic picks (+5.2 pts, 44.0%) kept; A0 2.25x +1.4 pts not significant.
Simulator switch 2 (2026-11-06): fork 1b05bdc (28 more game fixes, ~40% less CPU); leak tests pass; bests on it: A0 83.1%, A10 43.4%, A20 4.0%, Heart 15.2% (all within the predicted ranges).
Phase F4: second V iteration on 1b05bdc (120,000 games from the V-driven bests): holdout RMSE 0.4379 -> 0.4280, no measurable play change on any track (4 discards).
Phase F5: V also decides shop purchases, upgrades, rest vs smith and card removal — A10 +3.6 pts (45.4%, P 0.946) and A20 +0.86 floors kept; A0 -1.4 and Heart -1.6 discarded.

Phase F6: which V hooks matter, 20 arms + 2 extensions — six keeps. Shop-card and upgrade V help on all four tracks; V at rest sites hurt on A0/A10/A20 (dropping it: A10 +5.2 pts, A20 kept on 2,000 seeds); shop relics and removal depend on the track. Bests: A0 f6a0_upg, A10 f6a10_norest, A20 f6a20_norest, Heart f6heart_upg.
Phase F7: V's rest-vs-smith without the max-over-cards bias (value the upgrade the agent would actually make) — kept on A20 (+1.1 pts, new best f7a20), neutral on A10, still harmful on A0 and Heart.
Phase F8: V alone choosing every upgrade — no keep (A20 +0.5 pts on 2,000 seeds, pooled P 0.871; A0 −1.2 pts; A10 and Heart neutral): the hand card score still adds information.
Phase F9: cross-track parameter ports re-tested on the current simulator — no keep (the parameter differences between tracks are mostly track-specific).
Phase F10: V on event choices (leak-tested copies with fresh randomness; the event leak test caught and fixed a relic-pool-order leak) — neutral on A0/A10/A20, −2.9 pts on Heart.

Phases F11/F12: a Heart-track V trained on 15,000 Heart games with Heart labels — beat the old V on the holdout but, driving card picks alone, collapsed the Heart agent (−0.33 score); more rows of the same runs did not help. Finding: V's features contain no key flags, so no V can see whether a Heart win is still possible (parked: features v2 + far more Heart runs).

Phase F13 (measurement): current bests vs pre-F5 bests on 2,000 fresh seeds — A10 +3.0 pts, A0 +1.8, A20 +0.4 (all real, smaller than the single-slice keeps claimed); Heart −0.8 (the two Heart keeps did not hold).

Phase F14: Heart revert check (no revert: the two Heart agents are within noise on 4,000 seeds); a keys-aware Heart V trained on 255,000 runs moved Heart holdout correlation only 0.354 → 0.367 and was not selected (RMSE).
closed: Learned leaf value replacing rollouts at equal wall-clock (Phase S; S2 pending its scale-up).
Boss-fight value shapes, simulated elite gate, Neow ranking (all tracks).
Porting A0 keeps to the Heart track (none transferred).
Learning the 8 deck-model head weights against the run score (CV corr 0.288 → 0.301).
Speed micro-optimisation (1.03×; the remaining speed is architectural).

Phase P1: move prior v4 (2,000-sim targets) — +8.5 points at 50 sims but no gain at 500 sims (+0.6, P 0.67); with v4 the gap to 500 sims is 13.2 / 6.2 / 4.4 points at 50 / 100 / 200 sims (fidelity sim).
